acceptanceCriteria: tools/corvint-pr-tests full package runs under 15 minutes on a quiet host with unchanged assertions; timings recorded.
body: ci-shadow-historical-compat lane, 2026-10-16: go test tools/corvint-pr-tests took 1786.3 s at load 37-60 on the 12-core host (TestSelectedFailureAndFallback alone 357.8 s; a mutation run 636.9 s at load 90). At higher load the package will hit the -timeout 30m panic. Expected: package well under the hang detector (split, parallelize, or shrink fixtures) without weakening coverage.
title: tools/corvint-pr-tests package runs 1786 s against the 1800 s per-package timeout at load ~60
